description: This file defines the ClassSourcer class, which extends ASM's ClassVisitor to generate Java source code from Java class bytecode. It handles visiting class headers, fields, methods, annotations, and inner classes, and outputs corresponding source representations.

classes.name: ClassSourcer
classes.description: A class that extends ASM's ClassVisitor to generate Java source code representation from bytecode.

methods.name: visit
methods.description: Handles visiting class header information including version, access flags, class name, signature, superclass, and interfaces, and outputs the class declaration.

methods.name: visitAnnotation
methods.description: Handles visiting annotations on the class.

methods.name: visitField
methods.description: Handles visiting fields of the class, skipping synthetic fields.

methods.name: visitMethod
methods.description: Handles visiting methods of the class, returns a MethodSourcer to process method details.
